title: Categorical trace identity for a realized finite-stage Weil complex
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$, with $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ and $k=\overline{k_0}$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Y_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $K_E\in D^b_{c,\mathrm W}(Y,E)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Let $F$ act on $C_c=R\Gamma_c(Y,K_E)$ by global geometric Frobenius [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology, def-weil-global-geometric-frobenius]. For $n\ge1$, let $P_n=Y_0(\mathbf F_{q^n})$. For every $x\in P_n$ choose a geometric point $\bar x:s\to Y$ over $x$ and let $C_x=\operatorname{Fib}_s(L\bar x^*\operatorname{For}K_E)$ with local operator $f_{x,n}=F_x^{(n)}$ [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace].

Use the specified realization $(K_\Omega,\phi_\Omega)$ for the model Frobenius $\Phi$ and the specified compact-support and fixed-stalk comparisons of [lem-zl-general-condensed-weil-realization]. Put $\mathcal D_s=D^b_c(s)[[\operatorname{Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj}(\ell)]]$ and let $U_s$ be its coefficient unit. Write $P_c=Ra_{Y!}^{\mathrm{cond}}K_\Omega$ and $P_x=L\bar x^*K_\Omega$. Let $G_n$ and $v_{x,n}$ be exactly its globalOperator and stalkFrobenius for the $n$-th iterated Weil map [nt-assume-trace-formula]. Let $\rho_{E,s}$ be the finite-matrix point realization of [lem-zl-condensed-point-supertrace].

The set $P_n$ is finite and indexes the model-Frobenius fixed points; $C_c$ and the $C_x$ belong to $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$. The objects $P_c$ and $P_x$ have right duals. The specified comparison isomorphisms $w_c:P_c\simeq\rho_{E,s}(C_c)$ and $w_x:P_x\simeq\rho_{E,s}(C_x)$ satisfy
$$w_cG_n=\rho_{E,s}(F^n)w_c,\qquad w_xv_{x,n}=\rho_{E,s}(f_{x,n})w_x.$$
For every such choice of the geometric points, the categorical traces [sk-d-trace] satisfy
$$\operatorname{tr}_{\mathcal D_s}(G_n)=\sum_{x\in P_n}\operatorname{tr}_{\mathcal D_s}(v_{x,n})\quad\text{in }\operatorname{End}_{\mathcal D_s}(U_s).$$
